timeline.title: Front-End Lead
timeline.description:
Led an 8-person **Front-End** platform team empowering 15+ LATAM data squads to build internal interfaces for our collaborators. We delivered a component library (React + Ant Design) consumable by Dash and Next.js: teams stopped building UI from scratch to focus on business logic.
- **Front-end →** we enable teams, promote coherent interfaces and speed up development cycles through guides and continuous support.
- **UI →** we abstract the style layer, standardize visual presentation and surface component usage with monitoring dashboards.
- **UX →** we co-design user-centered flows, ensuring usable products that solve real problems.
- **DevEx →** we create a self-service developer experience and foster a user-focused engineering culture within the data & AI tribe.

timeline.title: Front-End Developer
timeline.description:
Drove evidence-backed changes at component level to improve usability and coherence across the company's e-commerce sites in 5 countries, enabling teams through **continuous experimentation**.
- Led adoption and internal training on VWO to run A/B tests across Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Peru.
- Designed and prototyped web component improvements focused on usability, accessibility and performance.
- Coded and analyzed A/B experiments, ensuring correct implementation of changes in production.
- Communicated actionable insights to stakeholders to guide evidence-based decisions and prioritize iterations.

timeline.title: CRO Business Analyst
timeline.description:
Led the optimization of **regional e-commerce**, focusing on experience and conversion.
- Proposed optimization initiatives for sites in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia and Peru.
- Coordinated joint efforts between commercial, UX, development and analytics teams.
- Designed Google Data Studio (Looker Studio) dashboards enabling continuous tracking of the digital funnel.
- Identified key friction points, prioritizing high-impact solutions for regional teams.

timeline.title: UX/UI Designer
timeline.description:
Raised the quality of the digital experience in internal and client projects through **advanced prototyping** and close collaboration with development.
- Built high-fidelity Figma prototypes to validate concepts in early stages.
- Applied Nielsen's usability heuristics to detect improvement opportunities.
- Facilitated design *hand-off* to development, reducing rework and ensuring visual coherence.
- Promoted collaborative practices between design and development through internal workshops.

timeline.title: Key Account Manager (KAM)
timeline.description:
Led the implementation of the **programming and innovation curriculum** for girls and young women.
- Sent more girls to the program's global competition than any other account manager that year.
- Coordinated volunteer teams to run interschool Technovation events.
- Supervised program adoption across 4 schools and 2 interschool venues, supporting teachers and students.
- Organized events and deliverables that sparked girls' interest in technology and entrepreneurship.
- Delivered informational talks to attract and motivate new volunteers to the program.

timeline.title: Freelance Graphic Designer & Web Developer
timeline.description:
Build **WordPress** sites that combine brand identity with high performance.
- Design graphic pieces for social media and stationery, reinforcing visual communication.
- Implement on-page SEO and content strategies to increase organic visibility.
- Configure security best practices and backups, keeping sites protected.
- Advise clients on UX and content, strengthening their overall digital presence.
- Have built sites for 60+ clients: artists, entrepreneurs and NGOs.

timeline.title: Postgraduate Diploma in Software Engineering
timeline.description:
Completed the **Postgraduate Diploma in Software Engineering**, deepening software engineering techniques, focusing on industry practices and technical project planning.
- **Curriculum:** requirements engineering, object-oriented programming, software architecture, technology update seminar and hands-on workshop.
- **Final project:** intelligent filtering microservice for public procurement bids.

timeline.title: Diploma in Web Development
timeline.description:
Completed the **Diploma in Web Development**, consolidating full-stack skills to design and build modern web applications.
- **Curriculum:** basic programming tools in Python, Python & the WWW (Django/Flask), advanced JavaScript, React development and integrative full-stack workshop.
- **Final project:** complete web application (React-Vite front-end + Python-Django backend) on currency exchange, demonstrating component architecture and state management.

timeline.title: Diploma in UX Design & Measurement
timeline.description:
Completed the **Diploma in UX Design & Measurement**, deepening experience design and UX measurement.
- **Curriculum:** UX fundamentals, user behavior, usability studies, UX design and management in digital transformation processes.
- **Final project:** comprehensive UX proposal with metrics framework and measurement plan for a personal finance digital product.

timeline.title: Foundations of User Experience (UX) Design
timeline.description:
Completed **Foundations of User Experience (UX) Design** (~13 h), acquiring the fundamentals of user-centered design and the role of an entry-level UX designer.
- **Curriculum:** user-centered design, design thinking framework, accessibility, equity-focused design, design sprints and UX career paths.
- **Final project:** hands-on activities simulating real scenarios (research, wireframes and prototyping) applied to a digital product case.

timeline.title: Inclusive Design for Digital Platforms
timeline.description:
Completed the **Inclusive Design for Digital Platforms** course (4 classes), deepening digital accessibility and the role of inclusive design.
- **Curriculum:** new disability paradigm, regulatory framework and guidelines (WCAG 2.1, WAI-ARIA), accessibility techniques and tools, testing with users with disabilities.
- **Final project:** accessibility audit and improvement recommendations for an existing platform.

timeline.title: Professional Degree in Design
timeline.description:
Earned the **Professional Degree in Design**, completing the bachelor's, licentiate and professional degree track.
- **Curriculum:** project studios, identity and product; ergonomics, structures and materials, production processes, interaction and UX, creative coding and data visualization.
- **Professional internships:** 240 h at Cencosud S.A. (UX design/e-commerce) and 360 h at TECHO-Chile (graphic design and communications).
- **Pre-degree project:** *Neotipos*, an exploration of algorithmic isotypes for adaptive visual identities.
- **Degree project:** *Algórica*, a web platform using interactive visualizations to teach mathematics in primary education.

timeline.title: Interdisciplinary Certificate in Digital Products & Services Development
timeline.description:
Earned the **Interdisciplinary Certificate in Digital Products and Services Development** (50 credits) integrating design, programming and communication to create digital solutions.
- **Curriculum:** Psychology Research Methodologies, Communication Technologies, Introduction to Programming, Interactive Storytelling and Media Convergence Workshop.
- **Applied focus:** interdisciplinary projects combining storytelling, UX and programming to prototype digital experiences.

timeline.title: Adjunct Professor – Faculty of Communications
timeline.description:
Designed and facilitated the **Graphic Nonfiction Narrative** course, integrating visual storytelling, data journalism and programming.
- Redesigned the syllabus incorporating data visualization and critical source analysis.
- Taught Python, Pandas and Altair to process datasets and create interactive visualizations.
- Guided student projects published in internal media and presented at academic events.
- Implemented iterative feedback that raised narrative clarity and visual quality of deliverables.

timeline.title: Instructor
timeline.description:
Taught the course **Introduction to AI for Girls** (4 sessions), bringing artificial intelligence fundamentals to teenagers through playful activities and critical reflection.
- Designed a curriculum covering AI history, applications, ethics and future scenarios.
- Led debates and interactive games to stimulate participation and critical thinking.
- Demonstrated machine learning live using Teachable Machine and neural network examples.
- Promoted awareness of algorithmic bias and the importance of diverse teams in technology.

timeline.title: Academic Coordinator – UC Continuing Education
timeline.description:
Managed the academic experience of faculty and students in the **Data Visualization Diploma**, ensuring the program ran smoothly.
- Managed the academic platform (Canvas), uploading materials, moderating forums and monitoring student progress.
- Coordinated communication between professors and 40+ participants, ensuring clarity on expectations and deadlines.
- Automated feedback delivery and partial certifications, speeding up response times.
- Provided technical assistance in synchronous classes (dataviz tools like Tableau, D3, Flourish), resolving issues in real time.
- Collected participation and satisfaction metrics to inform improvements for future editions.

timeline.title: Instructor
timeline.description:
Taught the course **Blended Learning and Hybrid Classroom Planning**, training teachers in mixed methodologies and digital tools.
- Trained 100+ teachers in pedagogical use of Canvas, Google Classroom and multimedia resources.
- Designed an intensive 4-module program (intro, ecosystem, backward design and planning) with asynchronous sessions and online workshops.
- Provided backward-planning templates and feedback guides to facilitate immediate classroom implementation.
- Coordinated follow-up and Q&A spaces, fostering sustainable adoption of hybrid classrooms.

timeline.title: Instructor
timeline.description:
Delivered the **Introduction to Ruby on Rails Bootcamp**, taking junior developers from zero to deploying their first web application.
- Structured an intensive 40 h program covering MVC, Active Record, REST routes and automated testing.
- Guided each student through environment setup, Git workflow and continuous deployment on Heroku.
- Designed practical challenges that consolidated clean code best practices and TDD.
- Facilitated final project presentations where students demonstrated their skills by building functional applications.
- Implemented personalized feedback that helped each participant improve their code and framework understanding.

timeline.title: Instructor
timeline.description:
Taught the **Front-End Bootcamp Mujeres Programadoras Quilicura**, training women from the district in web development and employability.
- Designed an introductory HTML, CSS and JavaScript curriculum oriented to practical projects.
- Facilitated weekly in-person workshops, 1:1 mentoring and code review.
- Supported the creation of *capstone* projects solving local needs and strengthening digital portfolios.

timeline.title: Private Tutor in Design & Web Development
timeline.description:
Gave private lessons in **Graphic Design and Web Development** adapted for a deaf student, communicating directly through visual language, gestures and written notes.
- Taught Adobe tools (Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign) to create visual identity and lay out graphic pieces.
- Introduced HTML5 and CSS3, guiding her in building a responsive web portfolio.
- Prepared high-contrast support material, step-by-step diagrams and captioned video tutorials to reinforce learning.
- Fostered her autonomy and confidence, providing inclusive resources and continuous learning paths.

timeline.title: Volunteer
timeline.description:
Volunteered at the **JavaScript Chile Conference (JSConf CL)**, collaborating in organizing and promoting the community event.
- Coordinated logistics for international speakers, rooms and streaming, ensuring a smooth experience for 500+ attendees.
- Designed graphic assets and social media content, consolidating the event's visual identity.
- Managed the registration and support team, optimizing check-in flow and answering questions in real time.

timeline.title: Front-End Community Lead
timeline.description:
Articulated best practices and collective learning among developers across the company's **retail and e-commerce** business units.
- Organized monthly meetups and workshops, strengthening a culture of technical exchange and mentoring among 50+ developers.
- Implemented an active communication channel to answer questions, share news and foster cross-team collaboration.

timeline.title: Graphic Designer
timeline.description:
Strengthened Fundación Antonia's **visual identity** and the communication of its violence prevention campaigns.
- Designed print and digital pieces for social media, workshops and awareness events.
- Developed brand guidelines and reusable templates, speeding up content production.
- Collaborated with the communications team on calendar planning and visual coherence of publications.
- Illustrated inclusive, empathetic educational material that connects with young audiences.
- Participated in creating gender-violence awareness campaigns, contributing a visual perspective aligned with its mission.

timeline.title: Mentor
timeline.description:
Guided teams of girls in the **Technovation Girls Chile** program as they created apps with social impact.
- Led the ideation, prototyping and pitch process, fostering leadership and critical thinking skills.
- Applied design thinking and low-code tools so participants could materialize their solutions.
- Supported preparation for regional and national competitions; one team earned top regional recognition in Valparaíso and 2nd place nationally in “Los Creadores”.
- Promoted long-term STEAM careers through continuous mentoring and support networks.
- Fostered participants' confidence and empowerment, helping them overcome gender barriers in technology.

timeline.title: Ambassador
timeline.description:
Served as an ambassador of **Women Techmakers (WTM)**, Google's global program providing visibility, community and resources for women in technology.
- Organized and supported technical and community events (IWD, talks, workshops) alongside GDG/WTM communities.
- Created content and learning opportunities, connecting people with resources and certifications from the Google ecosystem.
- Championed diversity, equity and inclusion in technology, building networks across communities and organizations.

timeline.title: Digital Content Creator & Web Developer
timeline.description:
Collaborate on demand creating blog content, incorporating **SEO** criteria and optimization for generative engines (**GEO**).
- Design and develop landing pages for products and events, connecting content, brand identity and communication goals.

timeline.title: Front-End Developer
timeline.description:
Design and develop an **interactive dashboard** for large touchscreens and tablets, visualizing Chilean transport data at national and regional scale.
- Integrate real-time speed, congestion and travel-time metrics.
- Let each user customize the information and visualizations to their needs.

timeline.title: Adjunct Professor – School of Design
timeline.description:
Teach the courses **Computational Thinking** and **Generative AI as an Engine for Design**, connecting design, programming and creative exploration.
- In **Computational Thinking**, teach programming fundamentals applied to design and the creative disciplines, through exercises and projects that explore code as a creation tool.
- In **Generative AI as an Engine for Design**, guide AI-assisted image generation, branding and interface projects, integrating experimentation, results validation and critical reflection on their ethical implications.

timeline.title: Graphic Design Professional Internship
timeline.description: Supported the Communications department's initiatives at **TECHO-Chile** with graphic pieces, print materials and presentations for campaigns and programs.

timeline.title: UX Design Professional Internship
timeline.description:
Combined interface design and internal communication within the **Digital Business Management (Department Stores)**.
- Participated in the initial design of the Paris app.
- Supported internal usability testing.
- Developed visual identity pieces for the division.
